title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop which consists of a single circle. Position the center of this circle at coordinates (0.0218, 0.0218) and set the radius to 0.0218. After completing the first sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0435 to the entire sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Next, transform the two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it with a vector of zero. To create the three-dimensional object, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Finally, perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded shape. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.04351914306791933 units in length, 0.04351914306791933 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0218, 0.0218)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0218)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the result

import cadquery as cq
import math

# Overall dimensions
outer_d = 0.0436
outer_r = outer_d / 2
height = 0.75

# Wall thickness
t = 0.005
inner_r = outer_r - t

# Create the hollow cylinder (tube)
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_r)
    .circle(inner_r)
    .extrude(height)
)
